The Blog

Lessons from living as a patient and a doctor

Many of these topics involve medicine, mental and physical health. Through narrative medicine I hope these stories give a greater understanding of what people go through. Alongside my own journey and the anonymous, de-identified stories of patients, I have included research and resources, to give insight and power to disempowered voices.

EDUCATIONAL CONTENT ONLY. NOT MEDICAL OR LEGAL ADVICE.
